caseName: New York v. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
caseNameFull: New York v. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission and Enron Power Marketing, Inc. v. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari in No. 00-568 granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition. Certiorari in No. 00-809 granted. Cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 225 F. 8d 667.
